title: Protecting the Trap Seal from Siphonage
description: A drain trap relies on a continuous water seal to prevent sewer gases from entering living spaces. A professional best practice is ensuring the trap is properly vented and protected against negative pressure. Unvented trap configurations often induce siphonage, pulling water completely out of the trap seal after a discharge. By utilizing a properly configured P-trap paired with an adequate fixture vent, air pressure remains balanced across the system. This preserves the trap water level, providing a reliable barrier against odorous and hazardous sewer atmospheric gases.
